summary: Adecoagro S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its first-quarter 2026 earnings press release and interim financial statements. The filing reports quarterly results, including Adjusted EBITDA of $85.8M, segment performance, and mentions one-off expenses from Tether's tender offer, but does not announce a new special situation. The Form 6-K is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer equivalent to a domestic earnings release. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return events detailed. The filing is standard and falls outside special-situation categories.
